biography.value:
Description

Iflytes are wicked, one-eyed fire genies brandishing large swords. They can fly on clouds of smoke that emit from the bottom halves of their body. Sometimes called a “cyclops,” but that's just being mean to them for only having one eye. - Imban

Defense

AC 25, touch 13, flat-footed 21 (+4 armor, +3 Dex, +1 dodge, +8 natural, -1 size)

hp 95 [140] (10d10+40)

mp 32 (currently 31)

Fort +7, Ref +10, Will +9

Immune confused, fire, poison; Resist ice 50%

Weakness water

Offense

Speed 20 ft., fly 40 ft. (perfect)

Melee 2 slams +15 (1d8+6 plus 1d6 fire and grab) or mwk falchion +16/+11 (2d6+9/18-20)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Beam, heat (1d6 fire)

Spells Known (FC CL 10th; concentration +12 (+16 casting defensively))

1st (DC 13) - Detonate (DC 14), Enspell (fire only), Fire (DC 14), Flame Breath (DC 14), Mage Armor (already cast), Ohspell (fire only), Produce Flame, Sleep

2nd (DC 14) - Burning Arc (DC 15), Detonate II (DC 15), Fiery Shuriken, Fire II (DC 15), Flaming Sphere (DC 15)

3rd (DC 15) - Detonate III (DC 16), Fira (DC 16), Fire III (DC 16), Sleepga

Statistics

Str 23, Dex 17, Con 18, Int 12, Wis 14, Cha 15

Base Atk +10; CMB +17 (+21 grapple); CMD 31

Feats Combat Casting, Combat Reflexes, Deceitful, Dodge, Elemental Focus (Fire), Improved Initiative*

*Bonus Feat

Skills Bluff +19, Craft (any one) +14, Disguise +10, Fly +13, Intimidate +15, Perception +15, Sense Motive +15, Spellcraft +14, Stealth +8

Languages Auran, Aquan, Common, Ignan, Terran; telepathy 100 ft.

Ecology

Environment dungeons or volcanic regions

Organization small group (1-3)

Treasure standard (mwk falchion, other treasure)

description.value: As a standard action, an iflyte fires a beam of destructive force from its eye as a ranged touch attack with a range of 100 feet, dealing 5d6 non-elemental damage.

effect: As a standard action, an iflyte fires a beam of destructive force from its eye as a ranged touch attack with a range of 100 feet, dealing 5d6 non-elemental damage.

description.value: An iflyte's body deals 1d6 points of fire damage whenever it hits in melee, or in each round it grapples.

effect: Already included where printed. Also on each round grappling; apply once.

description.unidentified: This sword has one curved, sharp edge like a scimitar, with the back edge unsharpened and either flat or slightly curved. Its weight is greater toward the end, making it better for chopping rather than stabbing.

effect: After a successful slam hit, attempt to grapple.
